sections.whatsHappening: You must serve documents on the other parties and file them with the court at various stages of your case. Each party must serve documents at each step in the court process, unless the Rules of the Small Claims Court provide otherwise. Serving documents means providing copies to all other parties involved in the case.
sections.whatToDoNext: At least 14 days before the settlement conference, you must serve on every other party and file with the court a copy of any document you will rely on at trial, including an expert report not attached to your claim or defence. You must also serve a list of proposed witnesses (Form 13A) and of other persons with knowledge of the matters in dispute. At least 30 days before the trial date, you must serve any written statement or document you wish to be received in evidence, unless the trial judge orders otherwise.
sections.whatHappensAfter: If you serve a document at least 30 days before the trial date, it shall be received in evidence unless the trial judge orders otherwise. If you do not serve documents within the required time frames, it may affect your ability to present your case.
